scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @pumpkin/server" "npm run dev -w @pumpkin/client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "HOST=0.0.0.0 npm run dev -w @pumpkin/server" "npm run dev -w @pumpkin/client -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pumpkin/shared && npm run build -w @pumpkin/server && npm run build -w @pumpkin/client
